items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: he brought a goat up to the classroom up on the third floor... He was a character.

ctx.x: Well, because... A good while back in school, he brought a goat up to the classroom up on the third floor. And the teacher put him on his... He was always in some kind of a jam with the teachers or something. He was a character. They had him in opportunity class for a while. And... He was just a little too much for the teachers.

Let's see. How would I say it now? Uh... He was sort of low on some of his, you know, prayers. And they were, you know, trying to find out why. I don't know. In fact, it was bugging him or something. Mm-hmm.
